description: Decodes rot13, base64, base64url, base32, hex, uuencode, urlcomponent, urlform, or html text back to the original. encoding in the result is "text" if the decoded bytes are valid UTF-8, or "base64" if they're binary.

format.description: rot13, base64, base64url, base32, hex, uuencode, urlcomponent, urlform, or html

name: encode_decode
